RECURSIVE Configs(_)
Configs(j) ==
  IF j = << >> THEN << >>
  ELSE IF Head(j).kind = "config"
       THEN <<Head(j).members>> \o Configs(Tail(j))
       ELSE Configs(Tail(j))

DiffOne(A, B) ==
  \/ /\ A \subseteq B /\ Cardinality(B \ A) = 1
  \/ /\ B \subseteq A /\ Cardinality(A \ B) = 1

PrevCommitted(m) ==
  LET idx == CfgIndex(journal[m])
  IN idx = 0 \/ commitIndex[m] >= idx

\* ---------- observable events ----------

NilCauses == << >>

Ev(event, proc, sq, ep, index, kind, cmd, conf, op, target, status, fr, causes) ==
  [event |-> event, proc |-> proc, seq |-> sq, epoch |-> ep, index |-> index,
   kind |-> kind, cmd |-> cmd, conf |-> conf, op |-> op, target |-> target,
   status |-> status, from |-> fr, causes |-> causes, links |-> {}]

FaultEv(sq, action, links) ==
  [event |-> "Fault", proc |-> "env", seq |-> sq, epoch |-> 0, index |-> 0,
   kind |-> "", cmd |-> "", conf |-> {}, op |-> action, target |-> "",
   status |-> "", from |-> 0, causes |-> NilCauses, links |-> links]

\* ---------- log merge (follower applying an extend) ----------

RECURSIVE AppendFrom(_)
AppendFrom(s) ==
  IF s.i > Len(s.entries) THEN s
  ELSE
    LET idx == s.prev + s.i
        ent == s.entries[s.i]
        sq == s.seq + 1
        cause == IF s.leaderApp[idx] > 0
                 THEN <<[proc |-> s.leader, seq |-> s.leaderApp[idx]]>>
                 ELSE NilCauses
        ev == Ev("Appended", s.proc, sq, ent.epoch, idx, ent.kind, ent.cmd,
                 ent.members, "", "", "", 0, cause)
    IN AppendFrom([s EXCEPT !.log = Append(s.log, ent),
                            !.app = [s.app EXCEPT ![idx] = sq],
                            !.seq = sq,
                            !.evs = Append(s.evs, ev),
                            !.i = s.i + 1])

RECURSIVE Merge(_)
Merge(s) ==
  IF s.i > Len(s.entries) THEN s
  ELSE
    LET idx == s.prev + s.i
        ent == s.entries[s.i]
    IN IF idx > Len(s.log) THEN AppendFrom(s)
       ELSE IF SameEntry(s.log[idx], ent)
            THEN Merge([s EXCEPT !.i = s.i + 1])
            ELSE
              LET truncBad == idx <= s.ci
                  kept == IF idx = 1 THEN << >> ELSE SubSeq(s.log, 1, idx - 1)
                  sq == s.seq + 1
                  tev == Ev("Truncated", s.proc, sq, 0, 0, "", "", {}, "", "",
                            "", idx, NilCauses)
                  cleared == [i \in 1..MaxLogLen |-> IF i >= idx THEN 0 ELSE s.app[i]]
                  s2 == [s EXCEPT !.log = kept,
                                 !.app = cleared,
                                 !.seq = sq,
                                 !.evs = Append(s.evs, tev),
                                 !.bad = s.bad \/ truncBad,
                                 !.trunc = idx]
              IN AppendFrom(s2)

RECURSIVE CommitEvs(_)
CommitEvs(s) ==
  IF s.i > s.n THEN s
  ELSE
    LET ent == s.log[s.i]
        sq == s.seq + 1
        cause == IF s.app[s.i] > 0
                 THEN <<[proc |-> s.proc, seq |-> s.app[s.i]]>>
                 ELSE NilCauses
        ev == Ev("Committed", s.proc, sq, ent.epoch, s.i, ent.kind, ent.cmd,
                 ent.members, "", "", "", 0, cause)
    IN CommitEvs([s EXCEPT !.i = s.i + 1, !.seq = sq,
                           !.evs = Append(s.evs, ev),
                           !.recs = s.recs \cup
                             {[index |-> s.i, kind |-> ent.kind, cmd |-> ent.cmd,
                               members |-> ent.members, entryEpoch |-> ent.epoch,
                               commitEpoch |-> s.cep]}])

\* ---------- scenario resolution ----------

UsesFollower(act) ==
  \/ act.at = "follower"
  \/ act.target = "follower"
  \/ \E i \in 1..Len(act.links) :
       \/ act.links[i][1] = "follower"
       \/ act.links[i][2] = "follower"

SubName(name, fol, el, cr) ==
  IF name = "follower" THEN fol
  ELSE IF name = "coordinator" THEN el
  ELSE IF name = "crashed" THEN cr
  ELSE name

NeedsName(act, name) ==
  \/ act.at = name
  \/ act.target = name
  \/ \E i \in 1..Len(act.links) : act.links[i][1] = name \/ act.links[i][2] = name

BuildPend(act, fol, el, cr) ==
  LET at == SubName(act.at, fol, el, cr)
      tg == SubName(act.target, fol, el, cr)
      n == Len(act.links)
      one(i) == <<SubName(act.links[i][1], fol, el, cr),
                  SubName(act.links[i][2], fol, el, cr)>>
      raw == IF n = 0 THEN {}
             ELSE IF act.kind = "cut"
             THEN {one(i) : i \in 1..n} \cup {<<one(i)[2], one(i)[1]>> : i \in 1..n}
             ELSE {one(i) : i \in 1..n}
      dirs == {d \in raw : d[1] /= d[2] /\ d[1] \in M /\ d[2] \in M}
  IN [kind |-> act.kind, at |-> at, target |-> tg, cmd |-> act.cmd, links |-> dirs]

Resolutions(step, el, cr, upf) ==
  IF step < 1 \/ step > Len(Steps) THEN {}
  ELSE
    LET act == Steps[step].action
        fols == {m \in M : upf[m] /\ m /= el}
        needsF == UsesFollower(act)
        choices == IF needsF THEN fols ELSE {"*"}
    IN IF needsF /\ fols = {} THEN {}
       ELSE IF NeedsName(act, "coordinator") /\ el \notin M THEN {}
       ELSE IF NeedsName(act, "crashed") /\ cr \notin M THEN {}
       ELSE {BuildPend(act, f, el, cr) : f \in choices}

MatchEv(ev, t) ==
  /\ t.kind = "event"
  /\ ev.event = t.event
  /\ (t.member = "" \/ ev.proc = t.member)
  /\ (t.index = -1 \/ ev.index = t.index)
  /\ (t.ekind = "" \/ ev.kind = t.ekind)
  /\ (t.status = "" \/ ev.status = t.status)
  /\ (t.epoch = -1 \/ ev.epoch = t.epoch)
  /\ (t.op = "" \/ ev.op = t.op)
  /\ (t.target = "" \/ ev.target = t.target)

AnyMatch(emitted, t) ==
  \E i \in 1..Len(emitted) : MatchEv(emitted[i], t)

LastOf(emitted, name, prev) ==
  LET hit == {i \in 1..Len(emitted) : emitted[i].event = name}
  IN IF hit = {} THEN prev ELSE emitted[CHOOSE i \in hit : \A j \in hit : j <= i].proc

\* ---------- base record ----------

Now ==
  [epoch |-> epoch, votedFor |-> votedFor, journal |-> journal, role |-> role,
   commitIndex |-> commitIndex, nextIndex |-> nextIndex, matchIndex |-> matchIndex,
   up |-> up, grants |-> grants, gseq |-> gseq, appSeq |-> appSeq, ch |-> ch,
   lnk |-> lnk, reply |-> reply, led |-> led, crecs |-> crecs, bad |-> bad,
   seq |-> seq, seqEnv |-> seqEnv, obs |-> obs, si |-> si, phase |-> phase,
   pend |-> pend, events |-> events, cap |-> cap, lastEl |-> lastEl,
   lastCr |-> lastCr, nCrash |-> nCrash, nAdmin |-> nAdmin, nLink |-> nLink]

Apply(r) ==
  /\ epoch' = r.epoch
  /\ votedFor' = r.votedFor
  /\ journal' = r.journal
  /\ role' = r.role
  /\ commitIndex' = r.commitIndex
  /\ nextIndex' = r.nextIndex
  /\ matchIndex' = r.matchIndex
  /\ up' = r.up
  /\ grants' = r.grants
  /\ gseq' = r.gseq
  /\ appSeq' = r.appSeq
  /\ ch' = r.ch
  /\ lnk' = r.lnk
  /\ reply' = r.reply
  /\ led' = r.led
  /\ crecs' = r.crecs
  /\ bad' = r.bad
  /\ seq' = r.seq
  /\ seqEnv' = r.seqEnv
  /\ obs' = r.obs
  /\ si' = r.si
  /\ phase' = r.phase
  /\ pend' = r.pend
  /\ events' = r.events
  /\ cap' = r.cap
  /\ lastEl' = r.lastEl
  /\ lastCr' = r.lastCr
  /\ nCrash' = r.nCrash
  /\ nAdmin' = r.nAdmin
  /\ nLink' = r.nLink

WithObs(r, emitted, el, cr) ==
  [r EXCEPT !.obs = emitted,
            !.events = r.events + Len(emitted),
            !.lastEl = IF el = "" THEN r.lastEl ELSE el,
            !.lastCr = IF cr = "" THEN r.lastCr ELSE cr]

Arm(r, step, el, cr, upf) ==
  LET res == Resolutions(step, el, cr, upf)
  IN IF step > Len(Steps) THEN
       [r EXCEPT !.phase = "settle", !.si = step, !.pend = NoPend,
                 !.cap = r.events + SettleN]
     ELSE IF Steps[step].trigger.kind = "start" /\ res /= {} THEN
       \* nondet picked by caller; this arm is the deterministic start case
       [r EXCEPT !.phase = "ready", !.si = step]
     ELSE IF Steps[step].trigger.kind = "event" /\ AnyMatch(r.obs, Steps[step].trigger)
             /\ res /= {} THEN
       [r EXCEPT !.phase = "ready", !.si = step]
     ELSE [r EXCEPT !.phase = "wait", !.si = step, !.pend = NoPend]

\* ---------- J1.5(a) at election ----------

Missing(log, ep) ==
  \E rec \in crecs :
    /\ rec.commitEpoch < ep
    /\ \/ rec.index > Len(log)
       \/ ~ SameEntry(log[rec.index],
                      [kind |-> rec.kind, epoch |-> rec.entryEpoch,
                       cmd |-> rec.cmd, members |-> rec.members])

\* Elected causes are built by CauseFrom / WinCauses, in member-name order.

RECURSIVE CauseFrom(_)
CauseFrom(s) ==
  IF s.i > 5 THEN s.out
  ELSE
    LET v == s.vs[s.i]
        take == \/ v \in s.grants
                \/ v = s.self
    IN IF take
       THEN CauseFrom([s EXCEPT !.i = s.i + 1,
                               !.out = Append(s.out, [proc |-> v, seq |-> s.gseq[v]])])
       ELSE CauseFrom([s EXCEPT !.i = s.i + 1])

WinCauses(r, m) ==
  LET C == ConfigOf(r.journal[m])
      grantsC == r.grants[m] \cap C
      self == IF m \in C THEN {m} ELSE {}
  IN CauseFrom([i |-> 1, vs |-> << "m1", "m2", "m3", "m4", "m5" >>,
                out |-> << >>, grants |-> grantsC \cup self,
                self |-> "", gseq |-> r.gseq])

NoteLeader(r, m) ==
  LET ep == r.epoch[m]
      sq == r.seq[m] + 1
      ev == Ev("Elected", m, sq, ep, 0, "", "", ConfigOf(r.journal[m]),
               "", "", "", 0, WinCauses(r, m))
      bad1 == IF Missing(r.journal[m], ep) THEN "J1.5" ELSE r.bad
  IN [r EXCEPT !.role[m] = "l",
              !.led = r.led \cup {<<ep, m>>},
              !.seq[m] = sq,
              !.obs = Append(r.obs, ev),
              !.nextIndex[m] = [p \in M |-> Len(r.journal[m]) + 1],
              !.matchIndex[m] = [p \in M |-> 0],
              !.bad = bad1,
              !.grants[m] = r.grants[m]]

\* ---------- actions ----------

\* MemberAfter wires scenario trigger detection for non-env actions.
MemberAfter(r) ==
  IF Explore
  THEN Apply([r EXCEPT !.events = events + Len(r.obs),
                       !.lastEl = LastOf(r.obs, "Elected", lastEl)])
  ELSE IF phase = "ready" \/ phase = "settle"
  THEN Apply([r EXCEPT !.events = events + Len(r.obs),
                       !.lastEl = LastOf(r.obs, "Elected", lastEl),
                       !.cap = cap, !.si = si, !.phase = phase, !.pend = pend])
  ELSE
    LET el == LastOf(r.obs, "Elected", lastEl)
        rE == [r EXCEPT !.events = events + Len(r.obs), !.lastEl = el]
        trig == IF si <= Len(Steps) THEN Steps[si].trigger ELSE [kind |-> "none"]
        res == IF si <= Len(Steps) THEN Resolutions(si, el, lastCr, up) ELSE {}
        fire == trig.kind = "event" /\ AnyMatch(r.obs, trig) /\ res /= {}
    IN IF fire
       THEN \E p \in res : Apply([rE EXCEPT !.phase = "ready", !.pend = p])
       ELSE Apply(rE)

\* Bounds, recorded in the README amendments. A member outside its own
\* configuration does not campaign. A member who can exchange messages with
\* an up coordinator of an epoch at least its own does not campaign, whether
\* or not that coordinator's configuration includes the member. A member does
\* not start a campaign while another up member is already a candidate.
\* double_vote ignores the reachable-coordinator half, and its Elect ends as
\* coordinator, so a second coordinator of the same epoch can still be elected.
ReachableLeader(m) ==
  \E l \in M :
    /\ l /= m
    /\ up[l]
    /\ role[l] = "l"
    /\ epoch[l] >= epoch[m]
    /\ lnk[l, m] /\ lnk[m, l]

Campaigning(m) ==
  \E other \in M :
    /\ other /= m
    /\ up[other]
    /\ role[other] = "c"

Elect(m) ==
  /\ up[m]
  /\ role[m] \in {"f", "c"}
  /\ epoch[m] < MaxEpoch
  /\ m \in ConfigOf(journal[m])
  /\ ~ Campaigning(m)
  /\ \/ Mutation = "double_vote"
     \/ ~ ReachableLeader(m)
  /\ LET e == epoch[m] + 1
         C == ConfigOf(journal[m])
         self == IF m \in C THEN 1 ELSE 0
         instant == \/ /\ Mutation = "double_vote" /\ m \in C
                    \/ IsMaj(self, C)
         r0 == [Now EXCEPT !.epoch[m] = e,
                           !.votedFor[m] = m,
                           !.grants[m] = {},
                           !.gseq[m] = seq[m],
                           !.role[m] = "c",
                           !.obs = << >>]
         r1 == IF instant THEN NoteLeader(r0, m) ELSE r0
     IN MemberAfter(r1)

Grant(v, c) ==
  /\ up[v] /\ up[c]
  /\ v /= c
  /\ role[c] = "c"
  /\ lnk[c, v] /\ lnk[v, c]
  /\ v \in ConfigOf(journal[c])
  /\ LET higher == epoch[c] > epoch[v]
         e1 == IF higher THEN epoch[c] ELSE epoch[v]
         vf == IF higher THEN None ELSE votedFor[v]
         voteOk == \/ Mutation = "double_vote"
                   \/ vf = None
                   \/ vf = c
         logOk == \/ Mutation = "skip_uptodate"
                  \/ UpToDate(journal[c], journal[v])
     IN /\ epoch[c] >= e1
        /\ voteOk
        /\ logOk
        /\ LET r0 == [Now EXCEPT !.epoch[v] = e1,
                                 !.votedFor[v] = c,
                                 !.role[v] = "f",
                                 !.gseq[v] = seq[v],
                                 !.grants[c] = grants[c] \cup {v},
                                 !.obs = << >>]
               C == ConfigOf(journal[c])
               cnt == Cardinality((grants[c] \cup {v}) \cap C)
                      + IF c \in C THEN 1 ELSE 0
               win == role[c] /= "l" /\ IsMaj(cnt, C)
               r1 == IF win THEN NoteLeader([r0 EXCEPT !.gseq[v] = seq[v]], c) ELSE r0
           IN MemberAfter(r1)

Learn(v, c) ==
  /\ up[v] /\ up[c]
  /\ role[c] = "c"
  /\ v /= c
  /\ lnk[c, v] /\ lnk[v, c]
  /\ v \in ConfigOf(journal[c])
  /\ epoch[v] > epoch[c]
  /\ LET r == [Now EXCEPT !.epoch[c] = epoch[v],
                          !.role[c] = "f",
                          !.votedFor[c] = None,
                          !.grants[c] = {},
                          !.obs = << >>]
     IN MemberAfter(r)

\* Apply leader m's extend to follower dst. Returns an updated Now-record
\* for the follower's state and a reply slot. Leader matchIndex is untouched.
SendExtend(m, dst) ==
  /\ up[m] /\ up[dst] /\ m /= dst
  /\ role[m] = "l"
  /\ lnk[m, dst]
  /\ \/ dst \in ConfigOf(journal[m])
     \/ /\ ch[m].phase = "catchup"
        /\ ch[m].target = dst
  /\ matchIndex[m][dst] < Len(journal[m]) \/ nextIndex[m][dst] <= Len(journal[m])
  /\ LET ni == nextIndex[m][dst]
         prev == ni - 1
         prevEp == IF prev <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE journal[m][prev].epoch
         entries == IF \/ ni > Len(journal[m])
                       \/ ni < 1
                    THEN << >>
                    ELSE SubSeq(journal[m], ni, Len(journal[m]))
         higher == epoch[dst] > epoch[m]
     IN IF higher
        THEN \* The follower's epoch is higher. The coordinator steps down in
             \* this action. The reply is not a separate state. See README.
             LET r == [Now EXCEPT !.epoch[m] = epoch[dst],
                                  !.role[m] = "f",
                                  !.votedFor[m] = None,
                                  !.grants[m] = {},
                                  !.reply[dst] = NoReply,
                                  !.obs = << >>]
             IN MemberAfter(r)
        ELSE
          LET newEp == Max(epoch[dst], epoch[m])
              newVF == IF epoch[m] > epoch[dst] THEN None ELSE votedFor[dst]
              newRole == IF epoch[m] > epoch[dst] THEN "f"
                         ELSE IF role[dst] = "c" /\ epoch[m] >= epoch[dst] THEN "f"
                         ELSE role[dst]
              prevOk == \/ prev = 0
                        \/ /\ prev <= Len(journal[dst])
                           /\ journal[dst][prev].epoch = prevEp
          IN IF ~ prevOk
             THEN LET r == [Now EXCEPT !.epoch[dst] = newEp,
                                       !.votedFor[dst] = newVF,
                                       !.role[dst] = newRole,
                                       !.nextIndex[m][dst] = Max(1, nextIndex[m][dst] - 1),
                                       !.reply[dst] = NoReply,
                                       !.obs = << >>]
                  IN MemberAfter(r)
             ELSE
               LET s0 == [log |-> journal[dst], app |-> appSeq[dst],
                          seq |-> seq[dst], evs |-> << >>, bad |-> FALSE,
                          i |-> 1, prev |-> prev, entries |-> entries,
                          proc |-> dst, leader |-> m, leaderApp |-> appSeq[m],
                          ci |-> commitIndex[dst], trunc |-> 0]
                   s1 == IF entries = << >> THEN s0 ELSE Merge(s0)
                   last == prev + Len(entries)
                   newCI == IF epoch[m] = newEp /\ commitIndex[m] > commitIndex[dst]
                            THEN Min(commitIndex[m], last)
                            ELSE commitIndex[dst]
                   s2 == IF newCI > commitIndex[dst]
                         THEN CommitEvs([log |-> s1.log, app |-> s1.app,
                                         seq |-> s1.seq, evs |-> s1.evs,
                                         i |-> commitIndex[dst] + 1, n |-> newCI,
                                         proc |-> dst, recs |-> {},
                                         cep |-> epoch[m]])
                         ELSE [evs |-> s1.evs, seq |-> s1.seq, recs |-> {},
                               app |-> s1.app]
                   oldC == ConfigOf(journal[dst])
                   newC == ConfigOf(s1.log)
                   oldI == CfgIndex(journal[dst])
                   newI == CfgIndex(s1.log)
                   sqC == s2.seq + 1
                   cfgEv == IF oldC /= newC
                            THEN Ev("ConfigInEffect", dst, sqC, 0, newI, "", "",
                                    newC, "", "", "", 0,
                                    IF s1.trunc > 0 /\ s1.seq > seq[dst]
                                    THEN <<[proc |-> dst, seq |->
                                            (CHOOSE q \in 1..s1.seq :
                                               \E k \in 1..Len(s1.evs) :
                                                 s1.evs[k].event = "Truncated"
                                                 /\ s1.evs[k].seq = q)]>>
                                    ELSE IF \E k \in 1..Len(s1.evs) :
                                              s1.evs[k].event = "Appended"
                                         THEN <<[proc |-> dst,
                                                 seq |-> s1.evs[CHOOSE k \in 1..Len(s1.evs) :
                                                   s1.evs[k].event = "Appended"
                                                   /\ \A j \in 1..Len(s1.evs) :
                                                     s1.evs[j].event = "Appended" => j <= k].seq]>>
                                         ELSE NilCauses)
                            ELSE [event |-> ""]
                   evs == IF oldC /= newC THEN Append(s2.evs, cfgEv) ELSE s2.evs
                   seqF == IF oldC /= newC THEN sqC ELSE s2.seq
                   r == [Now EXCEPT !.epoch[dst] = newEp,
                                    !.votedFor[dst] = newVF,
                                    !.role[dst] = newRole,
                                    !.journal[dst] = s1.log,
                                    !.appSeq[dst] = s2.app,
                                    !.seq[dst] = seqF,
                                    !.commitIndex[dst] = newCI,
                                    !.matchIndex[m][dst] = last,
                                    !.nextIndex[m][dst] = last + 1,
                                    !.reply[dst] = NoReply,
                                    !.bad = IF s1.bad THEN "J1.5" ELSE bad,
                                    !.obs = evs,
                                    !.grants[dst] = IF newRole = "f" /\ role[dst] = "c"
                                                    THEN {} ELSE grants[dst]]
               IN MemberAfter(r)

TakeReply(dst) ==
  /\ reply[dst].valid
  /\ up[reply[dst].to]
  /\ lnk[reply[dst].from, reply[dst].to]
  /\ LET rpy == reply[dst]
         ldr == rpy.to
     IN IF rpy.epoch > epoch[ldr]
        THEN LET r == [Now EXCEPT !.epoch[ldr] = rpy.epoch,
                                  !.role[ldr] = "f",
                                  !.votedFor[ldr] = None,
                                  !.grants[ldr] = {},
                                  !.reply[dst] = NoReply,
                                  !.obs = << >>]
             IN MemberAfter(r)
        ELSE IF role[ldr] = "l"
             THEN LET r == IF rpy.success
                           THEN [Now EXCEPT !.matchIndex[ldr][dst] = rpy.match,
                                             !.nextIndex[ldr][dst] = rpy.match + 1,
                                             !.reply[dst] = NoReply,
                                             !.obs = << >>]
                           ELSE [Now EXCEPT !.nextIndex[ldr][dst] =
                                            Max(1, nextIndex[ldr][dst] - 1),
                                             !.reply[dst] = NoReply,
                                             !.obs = << >>]
                  IN MemberAfter(r)
             ELSE LET r == [Now EXCEPT !.reply[dst] = NoReply, !.obs = << >>]
                  IN MemberAfter(r)

MajorityHas(m, n) ==
  LET C == ConfigOf(journal[m])
      have == {p \in C \ {m} : matchIndex[m][p] >= n}
      cnt == Cardinality(have) + IF m \in C /\ n <= Len(journal[m]) THEN 1 ELSE 0
  IN IsMaj(cnt, C)

AdvanceCommit(m) ==
  /\ up[m] /\ role[m] = "l"
  /\ LET goods == {n \in (commitIndex[m] + 1)..Len(journal[m]) :
                     /\ journal[m][n].epoch = epoch[m]
                     /\ MajorityHas(m, n)}
     IN /\ goods /= {}
        /\ LET N == CHOOSE n \in goods : \A k \in goods : k <= n
               s == CommitEvs([log |-> journal[m], app |-> appSeq[m],
                               seq |-> seq[m], evs |-> << >>,
                               i |-> commitIndex[m] + 1, n |-> N,
                               proc |-> m, recs |-> {}, cep |-> epoch[m]])
               r0 == [Now EXCEPT !.commitIndex[m] = N,
                                 !.seq[m] = s.seq,
                                 !.crecs = crecs \cup s.recs,
                                 !.obs = s.evs]
               r1 == IF Mutation = "skip_uptodate"
                     THEN [r0 EXCEPT !.journal[m] = << >>,
                                     !.bad = "J1.5",
                                     !.appSeq[m] = [i \in 1..MaxLogLen |-> 0]]
                     ELSE r0
           IN MemberAfter(r1)

OneExtra(S) == IF S = {} THEN {} ELSE {CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE}

NewMembers(op, C, target) ==
  IF Mutation = "wide_change"
  THEN IF op = "add"
       THEN C \cup {target} \cup OneExtra(M \ (C \cup {target}))
       ELSE C \ ({target} \cup OneExtra(C \ {target}))
  ELSE IF op = "add" THEN C \cup {target} ELSE C \ {target}

\* ---------- environment ----------

DropReplies(r, down) ==
  [d \in M |-> IF r.reply[d].valid /\ <<r.reply[d].from, r.reply[d].to>> \in down
               THEN NoReply ELSE r.reply[d]]

ActCrashBody(r, m) ==
  [r EXCEPT !.up[m] = FALSE, !.lastCr = m]

ActRestartBody(r, m) ==
  [r EXCEPT !.up[m] = TRUE,
            !.role[m] = "f",
            !.commitIndex[m] = 0,
            !.grants[m] = {},
            !.nextIndex[m] = [p \in M |-> 1],
            !.matchIndex[m] = [p \in M |-> 0],
            !.ch[m] = IdleCh]

FinishEnv(r, crashN, adminN, linkN) ==
  LET el == r.lastEl
      cr == r.lastCr
      r1 == [r EXCEPT !.nCrash = crashN, !.nAdmin = adminN, !.nLink = linkN,
                      !.events = events + Len(r.obs)]
  IN IF Explore
     THEN Apply(r1)
     ELSE IF si >= Len(Steps)
       THEN /\ PrintT("SCENARIO_DONE")
            /\ Apply([r1 EXCEPT !.phase = "settle",
                               !.si = si + 1,
                               !.pend = NoPend,
                               !.cap = r1.events + SettleN])
       ELSE
         LET nsi == si + 1
             trig == Steps[nsi].trigger
             res == Resolutions(nsi, el, cr, r.up)
             sync == trig.kind = "event" /\ AnyMatch(r.obs, trig) /\ res /= {}
             start == trig.kind = "start" /\ res /= {}
         IN IF sync \/ start
            THEN \E p \in res :
                   Apply([r1 EXCEPT !.phase = "ready", !.si = nsi, !.pend = p])
            ELSE Apply([r1 EXCEPT !.phase = "wait", !.si = nsi, !.pend = NoPend])

ActCommand(who, cmd, counting) ==
  /\ who \in M
  /\ LET fe == FaultEv(seqEnv + 1, "command", {})
     IN IF ~ up[who] \/ role[who] /= "l" \/ Len(journal[who]) >= MaxLogLen
        THEN LET r == [Now EXCEPT !.obs = <<fe>>, !.seqEnv = seqEnv + 1]
             IN IF counting
                THEN FinishEnv([r EXCEPT !.nAdmin = nAdmin + 1], nCrash, nAdmin + 1, nLink)
                ELSE FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink)
        ELSE
          LET ent == [kind |-> "command", epoch |-> epoch[who], cmd |-> cmd, members |-> {}]
              idx == Len(journal[who]) + 1
              sq == seq[who] + 1
              ev == Ev("Appended", who, sq, epoch[who], idx, "command", cmd, {},
                       "", "", "", 0, NilCauses)
              r == [Now EXCEPT !.journal[who] = Append(journal[who], ent),
                               !.appSeq[who][idx] = sq,
                               !.seq[who] = sq,
                               !.seqEnv = seqEnv + 1,
                               !.obs = <<ev, fe>>]
          IN IF counting
             THEN FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin + 1, nLink)
             ELSE FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink)

ActChange(who, op, target, counting) ==
  /\ who \in M /\ target \in M
  /\ LET sqE == seqEnv + 1
         fe == FaultEv(sqE, op, {})
         reqSq == seq[who] + 1
         req == Ev("ChangeRequested", who, reqSq, 0, 0, "", "", {}, op, target,
                   "", 0, NilCauses)
         replyEv(st, sq) == Ev("ChangeReplied", who, sq, 0, 0, "", "", {}, op,
                               target, st, 0, <<[proc |-> who, seq |-> reqSq]>>)
     IN IF ~ up[who] \/ role[who] /= "l"
        THEN LET sq2 == reqSq + 1
                 r == [Now EXCEPT !.seq[who] = sq2,
                                  !.seqEnv = sqE,
                                  !.obs = <<req, replyEv("not coordinator", sq2), fe>>]
             IN IF counting THEN FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin + 1, nLink)
                ELSE FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink)
        ELSE IF ch[who].phase /= "idle"
        THEN LET sq2 == reqSq + 1
                 r == [Now EXCEPT !.seq[who] = sq2, !.seqEnv = sqE,
                                  !.obs = <<req, replyEv("busy", sq2), fe>>]
             IN IF counting THEN FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin + 1, nLink)
                ELSE FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink)
        ELSE IF \/ /\ op = "add" /\ target \in ConfigOf(journal[who]) /\ Mutation /= "wide_change"
                \/ /\ op = "remove" /\ target \notin ConfigOf(journal[who]) /\ Mutation /= "wide_change"
        THEN LET sq2 == reqSq + 1
                 r == [Now EXCEPT !.seq[who] = sq2, !.seqEnv = sqE,
                                  !.obs = <<req, replyEv("reject", sq2), fe>>]
             IN IF counting THEN FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin + 1, nLink)
                ELSE FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink)
        ELSE
          LET phase1 == IF op = "remove" THEN "waitprev"
                        ELSE IF journal[target] = journal[who] THEN "waitprev"
                        ELSE "catchup"
              r == [Now EXCEPT !.ch[who] = [phase |-> phase1, op |-> op,
                                            target |-> target, rounds |-> 0, idx |-> 0],
                               !.seq[who] = reqSq,
                               !.seqEnv = sqE,
                               !.obs = <<req, fe>>]
          IN IF counting THEN FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin + 1, nLink)
             ELSE FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink)

ScenarioFire ==
  /\ ~Explore
  /\ phase = "ready"
  /\ si >= 1 /\ si <= Len(Steps)
  /\ LET k == pend.kind
     IN \/ /\ k = "crash" /\ pend.target \in M /\ up[pend.target]
           /\ LET fe == FaultEv(seqEnv + 1, "crash", {})
                  r == ActCrashBody([Now EXCEPT !.obs = <<fe>>,
                                               !.seqEnv = seqEnv + 1], pend.target)
              IN FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink)
        \/ /\ k = "restart" /\ pend.target \in M /\ ~ up[pend.target]
           /\ LET fe == FaultEv(seqEnv + 1, "restart", {})
                  r == ActRestartBody([Now EXCEPT !.obs = <<fe>>,
                                                  !.seqEnv = seqEnv + 1], pend.target)
              IN FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink)
        \/ /\ k = "heal"
           /\ LET fe == FaultEv(seqEnv + 1, "heal", {})
                  r == [Now EXCEPT !.lnk = [d \in M \X M |-> TRUE],
                                  !.obs = <<fe>>,
                                  !.seqEnv = seqEnv + 1]
              IN FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink)
        \/ /\ k \in {"cut", "drop"}
           /\ LET downs == pend.links
                  fe == FaultEv(seqEnv + 1, k, downs)
                  r0 == [Now EXCEPT !.lnk = [d \in M \X M |->
                                  IF d \in downs THEN FALSE ELSE lnk[d]],
                                  !.obs = <<fe>>,
                                  !.seqEnv = seqEnv + 1]
                  r == [r0 EXCEPT !.reply = DropReplies(r0, downs)]
              IN FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink)
        \/ /\ k = "command"
           /\ ActCommand(pend.at, pend.cmd, FALSE)
        \/ /\ k \in {"add", "remove"}
           /\ ActChange(pend.at, k, pend.target, FALSE)

TimeoutChange(m, status) ==
  LET reqSq == ch[m].op
      sq == seq[m] + 1
      ev == Ev("ChangeReplied", m, sq, 0, 0, "", "", {}, ch[m].op, ch[m].target,
               status, 0, NilCauses)
      r == [Now EXCEPT !.ch[m] = IdleCh, !.seq[m] = sq, !.obs = <<ev>>]
  IN MemberAfter(r)

AppendCfg(m, op, target) ==
  LET C == ConfigOf(journal[m])
      members == NewMembers(op, C, target)
      ent == [kind |-> "config", epoch |-> epoch[m], cmd |-> "", members |-> members]
      idx == Len(journal[m]) + 1
      sq == seq[m] + 1
      evA == Ev("Appended", m, sq, epoch[m], idx, "config", "", members, "", "",
                "", 0, NilCauses)
      sq2 == sq + 1
      evC == Ev("ConfigInEffect", m, sq2, 0, idx, "", "", members, "", "", "", 0,
                <<[proc |-> m, seq |-> sq]>>)
      r == [Now EXCEPT !.journal[m] = Append(journal[m], ent),
                       !.appSeq[m][idx] = sq,
                       !.seq[m] = sq2,
                       !.ch[m] = [phase |-> "waitcommit", op |-> op,
                                  target |-> target, rounds |-> ch[m].rounds,
                                  idx |-> idx],
                       !.obs = <<evA, evC>>]
  IN MemberAfter(r)

FinishChange(m) ==
  LET sq == seq[m] + 1
      ev == Ev("ChangeReplied", m, sq, 0, 0, "", "", {}, ch[m].op, ch[m].target,
               "ok", 0, NilCauses)
      stepdown == ch[m].op = "remove" /\ ch[m].target = m
      r == [Now EXCEPT !.ch[m] = IdleCh,
                       !.seq[m] = sq,
                       !.role[m] = IF stepdown THEN "f" ELSE role[m],
                       !.obs = <<ev>>]
  IN MemberAfter(r)

ChangeTimeout(m) ==
  /\ up[m] /\ role[m] = "l"
  /\ ch[m].phase = "catchup"
  /\ TimeoutChange(m, "timeout")

\* A catch-up round that does not go through the broken CatchupSend conjunction.
CatchupRound(m) ==
  /\ up[m] /\ role[m] = "l"
  /\ ch[m].phase = "catchup"
  /\ ch[m].rounds < MaxRounds
  /\ journal[ch[m].target] /= journal[m]
  /\ up[ch[m].target]
  /\ lnk[m, ch[m].target]
  /\ LET target == ch[m].target
         ni0 == nextIndex[m][target]
         ni == IF ni0 > Len(journal[m]) + 1 THEN Len(journal[m]) + 1
               ELSE IF ni0 < 1 THEN 1 ELSE ni0
         prev == ni - 1
         prevEp == IF prev <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE journal[m][prev].epoch
         entries == IF ni > Len(journal[m]) THEN << >>
                    ELSE SubSeq(journal[m], ni, Len(journal[m]))
         dst == target
         higher == epoch[dst] > epoch[m]
     IN IF higher
        THEN LET r == [Now EXCEPT !.epoch[m] = epoch[dst],
                                  !.role[m] = "f",
                                  !.votedFor[m] = None,
                                  !.grants[m] = {},
                                  !.reply[dst] = NoReply,
                                  !.ch[m].rounds = ch[m].rounds + 1,
                                  !.obs = << >>]
             IN MemberAfter(r)
        ELSE
          LET newEp == Max(epoch[dst], epoch[m])
              newVF == IF epoch[m] > epoch[dst] THEN None ELSE votedFor[dst]
              newRole == IF epoch[m] > epoch[dst] THEN "f"
                         ELSE IF role[dst] = "c" /\ epoch[m] >= epoch[dst] THEN "f"
                         ELSE role[dst]
              prevOk == \/ prev = 0
                        \/ /\ prev <= Len(journal[dst])
                           /\ journal[dst][prev].epoch = prevEp
          IN IF ~ prevOk
             THEN LET r == [Now EXCEPT !.epoch[dst] = newEp,
                                       !.votedFor[dst] = newVF,
                                       !.role[dst] = newRole,
                                       !.nextIndex[m][dst] = Max(1, nextIndex[m][dst] - 1),
                                       !.reply[dst] = NoReply,
                                       !.ch[m].rounds = ch[m].rounds + 1,
                                       !.obs = << >>]
                  IN MemberAfter(r)
             ELSE
               LET s0 == [log |-> journal[dst], app |-> appSeq[dst],
                          seq |-> seq[dst], evs |-> << >>, bad |-> FALSE,
                          i |-> 1, prev |-> prev, entries |-> entries,
                          proc |-> dst, leader |-> m, leaderApp |-> appSeq[m],
                          ci |-> commitIndex[dst], trunc |-> 0]
                   s1 == IF entries = << >> THEN s0 ELSE Merge(s0)
                   last == prev + Len(entries)
                   newCI == IF epoch[m] = newEp /\ commitIndex[m] > commitIndex[dst]
                            THEN Min(commitIndex[m], last) ELSE commitIndex[dst]
                   s2 == IF newCI > commitIndex[dst]
                         THEN CommitEvs([log |-> s1.log, app |-> s1.app,
                                         seq |-> s1.seq, evs |-> s1.evs,
                                         i |-> commitIndex[dst] + 1, n |-> newCI,
                                         proc |-> dst, recs |-> {}, cep |-> epoch[m]])
                         ELSE [evs |-> s1.evs, seq |-> s1.seq, recs |-> {}, app |-> s1.app]
                   oldC == ConfigOf(journal[dst])
                   newC == ConfigOf(s1.log)
                   sqC == s2.seq + 1
                   \* cause: last Appended or the Truncated in s1.evs
                   cause == IF \E k \in 1..Len(s1.evs) : s1.evs[k].event = "Appended"
                            THEN <<[proc |-> dst, seq |->
                                    s1.evs[CHOOSE k \in 1..Len(s1.evs) :
                                      /\ s1.evs[k].event = "Appended"
                                      /\ \A j \in 1..Len(s1.evs) :
                                           s1.evs[j].event = "Appended" => j <= k].seq]>>
                            ELSE IF \E k \in 1..Len(s1.evs) : s1.evs[k].event = "Truncated"
                                 THEN <<[proc |-> dst, seq |->
                                         s1.evs[CHOOSE k \in 1..Len(s1.evs) :
                                           s1.evs[k].event = "Truncated"].seq]>>
                                 ELSE NilCauses
                   evs == IF oldC /= newC
                          THEN Append(s2.evs,
                                 Ev("ConfigInEffect", dst, sqC, 0, CfgIndex(s1.log),
                                    "", "", newC, "", "", "", 0, cause))
                          ELSE s2.evs
                   seqF == IF oldC /= newC THEN sqC ELSE s2.seq
                   r == [Now EXCEPT !.epoch[dst] = newEp,
                                    !.votedFor[dst] = newVF,
                                    !.role[dst] = newRole,
                                    !.journal[dst] = s1.log,
                                    !.appSeq[dst] = s2.app,
                                    !.seq[dst] = seqF,
                                    !.commitIndex[dst] = newCI,
                                    !.matchIndex[m][dst] = last,
                                    !.nextIndex[m][dst] = last + 1,
                                    !.reply[dst] = NoReply,
                                    !.bad = IF s1.bad THEN "J1.5" ELSE bad,
                                    !.ch[m].rounds = ch[m].rounds + 1,
                                    !.obs = evs,
                                    !.grants[dst] = IF newRole = "f" /\ role[dst] = "c"
                                                    THEN {} ELSE grants[dst]]
               IN MemberAfter(r)

ExploreCrash(m) ==
  /\ Explore /\ up[m] /\ nCrash < MaxCrashes
  /\ LET fe == FaultEv(seqEnv + 1, "crash", {})
         r == ActCrashBody([Now EXCEPT !.obs = <<fe>>, !.seqEnv = seqEnv + 1], m)
     IN FinishEnv(r, nCrash + 1, nAdmin, nLink)

ExploreRestart(m) ==
  /\ Explore /\ ~ up[m]
  /\ LET fe == FaultEv(seqEnv + 1, "restart", {})
         r == ActRestartBody([Now EXCEPT !.obs = <<fe>>, !.seqEnv = seqEnv + 1], m)
     IN FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink)

ExploreCommand(m, c) ==
  /\ Explore /\ nAdmin < MaxAdmin /\ c \in Commands
  /\ ActCommand(m, c, TRUE)

ExploreChange(m, op, t) ==
  /\ Explore /\ nAdmin < MaxAdmin /\ m \in M /\ t \in M /\ op \in {"add", "remove"}
  /\ ActChange(m, op, t, TRUE)

ExploreCut(a, b) ==
  /\ Explore /\ nLink < MaxLinkFaults /\ a \in M /\ b \in M /\ a /= b
  /\ LET downs == {<<a, b>>, <<b, a>>}
         links == {<<a, b>>, <<b, a>>}
         fe == FaultEv(seqEnv + 1, "cut", links)
         r0 == [Now EXCEPT !.lnk = [d \in M \X M |-> IF d \in downs THEN FALSE ELSE lnk[d]],
                         !.obs = <<fe>>, !.seqEnv = seqEnv + 1]
         r == [r0 EXCEPT !.reply = DropReplies(r0, downs)]
     IN FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink + 1)

ExploreDrop(a, b) ==
  /\ Explore /\ nLink < MaxLinkFaults /\ a \in M /\ b \in M /\ a /= b
  /\ LET downs == {<<a, b>>}
         links == {<<a, b>>}
         fe == FaultEv(seqEnv + 1, "drop", links)
         r0 == [Now EXCEPT !.lnk = [d \in M \X M |-> IF d \in downs THEN FALSE ELSE lnk[d]],
                         !.obs = <<fe>>, !.seqEnv = seqEnv + 1]
         r == [r0 EXCEPT !.reply = DropReplies(r0, downs)]
     IN FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink + 1)

ExploreHeal ==
  /\ Explore
  /\ \E a, b \in M : a /= b /\ ~ lnk[a, b]
  /\ LET fe == FaultEv(seqEnv + 1, "heal", {})
         r == [Now EXCEPT !.lnk = [d \in M \X M |-> TRUE],
                         !.obs = <<fe>>, !.seqEnv = seqEnv + 1]
     IN FinishEnv(r, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink)

Next ==
  \/ \E m \in M : Elect(m)
  \/ \E v \in M, c \in M : Grant(v, c)
  \/ \E v \in M, c \in M : Learn(v, c)
  \/ \E m \in M, d \in M : SendExtend(m, d)
  \/ \E d \in M : TakeReply(d)
  \/ \E m \in M : AdvanceCommit(m)
  \/ \E m \in M : \/ /\ ch[m].phase = "catchup"
                    /\ journal[ch[m].target] = journal[m]
                    /\ up[m] /\ role[m] = "l"
                    /\ MemberAfter([Now EXCEPT !.ch[m].phase = "waitprev", !.obs = << >>])
                 \/ /\ ch[m].phase = "catchup"
                    /\ journal[ch[m].target] /= journal[m]
                    /\ ch[m].rounds >= MaxRounds
                    /\ up[m] /\ role[m] = "l"
                    /\ TimeoutChange(m, "timeout")
                 \/ CatchupRound(m)
                 \/ /\ ch[m].phase = "waitprev"
                    /\ up[m] /\ role[m] = "l"
                    /\ PrevCommitted(m)
                    /\ Len(journal[m]) < MaxLogLen
                    /\ AppendCfg(m, ch[m].op, ch[m].target)
                 \/ /\ ch[m].phase = "waitcommit"
                    /\ up[m] /\ role[m] = "l"
                    /\ commitIndex[m] >= ch[m].idx
                    /\ FinishChange(m)
  \/ \E m \in M : ChangeTimeout(m)
  \/ ScenarioFire
  \/ \E m \in M : ExploreCrash(m)
  \/ \E m \in M : ExploreRestart(m)
  \/ \E m \in M, c \in Commands : ExploreCommand(m, c)
  \/ \E m \in M, t \in M, op \in {"add", "remove"} : ExploreChange(m, op, t)
  \/ \E a \in M, b \in M : ExploreCut(a, b)
  \/ \E a \in M, b \in M : ExploreDrop(a, b)
  \/ ExploreHeal

\* ---------- invariants (derives: J1.1, J1.3, J1.5) ----------

J11 == \A e \in 1..MaxEpoch : Cardinality({m \in M : <<e, m>> \in led}) <= 1

J13 ==
  \A m \in M :
    LET cs == <<InitialConfig>> \o Configs(journal[m])
    IN \A i \in 1..(Len(cs) - 1) : DiffOne(cs[i], cs[i + 1])

J15 == bad = "none"

StateConstraint ==
  /\ events <= cap
  /\ \A m \in M : Len(journal[m]) <= MaxLogLen
  /\ \A m \in M : epoch[m] <= MaxEpoch

\* Trace counters are not part of state identity. A cycle that restores the
\* protocol state and only bumps these counters is one state. led, crecs, and
\* bad stay in the view, so J1.1 and J1.5 still see them. The stored state
\* still carries obs and seq, and the observe file is rebuilt from the trace.
\* Recorded in the README.
View == <<epoch, votedFor, journal, role, commitIndex, nextIndex, matchIndex,
          up, grants, ch, lnk, reply, led, crecs, bad, si, phase, pend, cap,
          lastEl, lastCr, nCrash, nAdmin, nLink>>

\* Fairness is stated and not used. The checker assumes none: the contract has
\* no liveness clause, and a fairness assumption would only hide safety
\* violations. What is allowed, were liveness checked, is weak fairness of each
\* member's own actions and of reply delivery while the reply's link is up.
\* derives: G1.2, failure-model clocks.
MemberStep(m) ==
  \/ Elect(m)
  \/ \E v \in M : Grant(v, m)
  \/ \E c \in M : Grant(m, c)
  \/ \E d \in M : SendExtend(m, d)
  \/ AdvanceCommit(m)
  \/ ChangeTimeout(m)

Fairness ==
  /\ \A m \in M : WF_vars(Elect(m))
  /\ \A m \in M : WF_vars(\E d \in M : SendExtend(m, d))
  /\ \A d \in M : WF_vars(TakeReply(d) /\ lnk[reply[d].from, reply[d].to])

Init ==
  /\ epoch = [m \in M |-> 0]
  /\ votedFor = [m \in M |-> None]
  /\ journal = [m \in M |-> << >>]
  /\ role = [m \in M |-> "f"]
  /\ commitIndex = [m \in M |-> 0]
  /\ nextIndex = [m \in M |-> [p \in M |-> 1]]
  /\ matchIndex = [m \in M |-> [p \in M |-> 0]]
  /\ up = [m \in M |-> TRUE]
  /\ grants = [m \in M |-> {}]
  /\ gseq = [m \in M |-> 0]
  /\ appSeq = [m \in M |-> [i \in 1..MaxLogLen |-> 0]]
  /\ ch = [m \in M |-> IdleCh]
  /\ lnk = [d \in M \X M |-> TRUE]
  /\ reply = [m \in M |-> NoReply]
  /\ led = {}
  /\ crecs = {}
  /\ bad = "none"
  /\ seq = [m \in M |-> 0]
  /\ seqEnv = 0
  /\ obs = << >>
  /\ events = 0
  /\ cap = MaxEvents
  /\ lastEl = None
  /\ lastCr = None
  /\ nCrash = 0
  /\ nAdmin = 0
  /\ nLink = 0
  /\ IF Explore \/ Len(Steps) = 0
     THEN /\ si = 1 /\ phase = "wait" /\ pend = NoPend
          /\ IF ~Explore /\ Len(Steps) = 0 THEN PrintT("SCENARIO_DONE") ELSE TRUE
     ELSE /\ si = 1
          /\ IF Steps[1].trigger.kind = "start"
             THEN /\ phase = "ready"
                  /\ pend \in Resolutions(1, None, None, [m \in M |-> TRUE])
             ELSE /\ phase = "wait" /\ pend = NoPend

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
\* FairSpec is not checked. See Fairness above.
FairSpec == Spec /\ Fairness

====

README.md.content:
# Model of Specification F

TLA+ model of `replay/spec-F.md` for the replay's model arm. `model/Journal.tla` is the protocol. `model/run.sh` compiles a scenario file (`replay/scenario-format.md`) into a TLC configuration, runs TLC, and prints `PASS`, `FAIL <clause>`, or `UNEXPLAINED <reason>`. A trace, when TLC produces one, is written to `model/observe/<run>.jsonl` in the form of `replay/observe.md`, with `"side": "model"`.

TLC is `tla2tools.jar` from `~/projects/tlaplus` (TLC 2.19, 08 Aug 2024). Every run is under `systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=24G -p MemorySwapMax=0`, with the JVM heap at 16G and `-workers auto`. Deadlock checking is off.

This file's Choices, Concerns, and Predictions were written before any scenario or mutation was checked.

## Choices

Where the specification is silent, or where a finite check has to represent an unbounded network, these are the readings the model uses.

1. A ballot is not a stored message. The voter grants in one action, and only while both directions of the link are up. The action reads the candidate's journal and the candidate's current epoch at that moment. Taking the same grant again changes nothing. A lost ballot is a grant that is never taken. A delayed ballot is a grant taken later. Reordering is the order of grant actions. A reply to the candidate that would carry an older epoch is outside this representation, because there is no buffered request.

2. An extend is applied to the follower inside the coordinator's send. The follower leaves one reply. A later send replaces an untaken reply, and the replaced reply is lost. Two extends to the same follower are not in flight together, and a reply is not delivered twice. Delay of an extend, while the link is up, is the send not having been taken yet. A send on a down link is dropped and not queued.

3. A reply carries three fields the message list does not name: success or failure, the match index, and the sender's epoch. A reply whose epoch is higher than the coordinator's makes the coordinator a follower and clears `votedFor`. It is not also applied as a success or a failure. A reply at an equal or lower epoch is applied. Success sets `matchIndex` to the last index the request carried and `nextIndex` to one past that. Failure decreases `nextIndex`. `nextIndex` stays at least 1, so `prevIndex` does not go below 0.

4. The durable vote and the grant are one action. A grant has no observable event of its own. An `Elected` cause names each counting voter by `(proc, seq)` where `seq` is that member's latest observable record at the grant, or 0 when the member has none. The candidate's own vote uses the same rule, with the sequence number of the candidate's latest record when the election begins. Causes are ordered by member name.

5. `Elect` is the election timeout. It is enabled for every up follower and candidate whose epoch is below `MaxEpoch`. An extend or a grant does not disable it. A coordinator does not take it. There is no timer variable. Once `matchIndex` has caught the log and `nextIndex` is past the end, the empty extend is not sent: it would change no stored state. The specification's periodic heartbeat has no clock to hang on here.

6. Catch-up sends at most `MaxRounds` extends. A `timeout` reply is enabled the whole time the change is in catch-up. Waiting for the previous configuration to commit, and waiting for the new entry to commit, have no timeout. If the new member's journal already equals the coordinator's, catch-up is over at once and the change moves to the commit wait. A change request while one is already in progress is answered `busy`. An add of a member already in the configuration, or a remove of a member who is absent, is answered `reject` (the `wide_change` mutation does not reject). The specification names `not coordinator`, `timeout`, and `ok`. `busy` and `reject` are the answers for the cases it leaves unnamed. `not coordinator` is checked first. The pending change is volatile and disappears on a crash.

7. One extend carries the suffix from `nextIndex` through the last entry. An existing entry is the sent entry when kind, epoch, command, and members all agree. The specification defines a conflict as the same index and a different epoch. The same epoch with a different payload is left open; the model treats that pair as a conflict and truncates from that index.

8. The commitment action sets `commitIndex` to the largest eligible index and emits `Committed` for every newly covered index. `crecs` records each of those, with `commitEpoch` equal to the coordinator's current epoch. 9. `ConfigInEffect` is emitted when an append or a truncation changes the configuration the member is using. Index 0 means the journal has no configuration entry, so the initial configuration is in effect.

10. A coordinator who is sent an extend of its own epoch stays coordinator and applies the entries. A candidate who is sent an extend of an epoch at least its own becomes a follower and then applies them. A higher epoch on any message is adopted first: `epoch` moves up, `votedFor` is cleared, the role becomes follower.

11. The coordinator's own match is not a stored `matchIndex`. The majority count includes the coordinator when the coordinator belongs to the configuration and the index sits in the coordinator's journal. More than half means `2 * count > Cardinality(C)`. A one-member configuration wins inside `Elect`, with no grant. A candidate who is outside its own configuration does not count itself. 12. A crash leaves the network and any queued reply alone. `cut` and `drop` discard a queued reply whose direction is one of the links just failed. `heal` raises every link and does not put those replies back. Link failures accumulate until `heal`. A self-pair in `cut` or `drop` is ignored.

15. All five members start up, at epoch 0, `votedFor` none, journal empty, role follower, `commitIndex` 0. The configuration each one uses is the scenario's `initial` list until a configuration entry appears in that member's journal. ## Concerns

From the specification, before any run. Each one names a shape that would show it.

1. Success and failure replies are applied unconditionally. An older success, delivered after a newer one, can move `matchIndex` backward, and a string of failure replies can walk `nextIndex` down. A commit can then count a follower who no longer holds the entry. Shape: one follower, two extend replies in flight, the later applied first, then the earlier success, then a commit of an index that follower has since lost. The one-reply slot in Choices 2 cannot exhibit this. The concern stands, and this model will not produce the trace.

2. A member outside the initial configuration still has that configuration as its own, and the election rule lets that member become coordinator of it. `m5` does not count itself, and three grants from `{m1, m2, m3, m4}` are a majority of four. Shape: no admin request, journals still empty so `m5` is up to date, `m5` times out and is granted by `m1`, `m2`, and `m3`. I do not claim this breaks J1.1 or J1.5. The design allows a coordinator who is not a member of the configuration it leads.

3. The reason given for one-member changes is that any majority of the old configuration overlaps any majority of the new one. That sentence does not mention the up-to-date check or the single vote in an epoch, and overlap of adjacent majorities is the whole of the written argument. The wait (do not append another configuration entry while the previous one is uncommitted) is what keeps a third configuration from being appended beside an uncommitted second. Shape that would show a real break in leader completeness: a configuration entry committed by a majority that excludes the previous coordinator, then a partition, then a new coordinator whose journal lacks that committed entry. S7 is the nearest shared scenario. I predict S7 passes. The concern is that the written justification is thinner than the property.

4. Adding a member who is already in the configuration, or removing one who is absent, has no specified answer. Appending either request would write a configuration equal to the current one, and J1.3 would fail. The model answers `reject` and does not append (Choice 6). Shape, if the append were done: after `Elected`, `{add: m1, at: coordinator}` with `m1` in the initial configuration.

5. A coordinator who hears another coordinator of the same epoch does not step down. The step-down rules are a higher epoch, and a candidate hearing a coordinator of an epoch at least its own. Two coordinators of one epoch stay coordinators. Shape: the `double_vote` mutation, in which two members become coordinator of one epoch. J1.1 has already failed; the design gives no later action that repairs it.

# Model of Specification F

TLA+ model of `replay/spec-F.md` for the replay's model arm. `model/Journal.tla` is the protocol. `model/run.sh` compiles a scenario file (`replay/scenario-format.md`) into a TLC configuration, runs TLC, and prints `PASS`, `FAIL <clause>`, or `UNEXPLAINED <reason>`. A trace, when TLC produces one, is written to `model/observe/<run>.jsonl` in the form of `replay/observe.md`, with `"side": "model"`.

TLC is `tla2tools.jar` from `~/projects/tlaplus` (TLC 2.19, 08 Aug 2024). Every run is under `systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=24G -p MemorySwapMax=0`, with the JVM heap at 16G and `-workers auto`. Deadlock checking is off.

A delayed ballot is a grant taken later. Reordering is the order of grant actions. A reply to the candidate that would carry an older epoch is outside this representation, because there is no buffered request.

2. An extend is applied to the follower inside the coordinator's send. The follower leaves one reply. A later send replaces an untaken reply, and the replaced reply is lost. Two extends to the same follower are not in flight together, and a reply is not delivered twice. Delay of an extend, while the link is up, is the send not having been taken yet. A send on a down link is dropped and not queued.

3. A reply carries three fields the message list does not name: success or failure, the match index, and the sender's epoch. An election-only skeleton at this cap was about two million distinct states and fit well under the heap. |
| MaxLogLen | 4 | S8 appends three configuration entries on a completing path. The fourth slot is spare. S4's completing path is one command and one configuration entry. |
| MaxRounds | 3 | Catch-up of an empty journal over a short log is one successful extend. Two further rounds cover a failure reply and a retry. |
| Heap | 16G | Inside the 24G scope, leaving room for TLC's native and off-heap use. |
| Workers | auto | One TLC process per run. Runs are sequential so two heaps are not live. |

Scenario event caps and settle counts come from the scenario file. The shared scenarios use 400 and 100.

`--explore` uses the same epoch, log, and round caps, with no scenario steps. Its fault counters are `MaxCrashes = 1`, `MaxAdmin = 3`, `MaxLinkFaults = 4`, `Commands = {c1}`, and an event cap of 400. No shared scenario crashes a member more than once or issues more than three admin requests (S8). S6's cut is four undirected pairs, and explore fails one undirected pair per action, so four is the smallest counter that still contains that cut. The event cap matches the shared scenarios' `bound.events`, which is enough for a short completing path. Grants and other actions that emit no observable event are bounded by the epoch and log caps, not by the event cap.

The initial configuration of the explore run is `{m1, m2, m3, m4}`, the same list the shared scenarios use.

An extend no longer leaves a reply for a later action. On success, `matchIndex` and `nextIndex` update in the same action as the follower's journal. On a rejected prefix, `nextIndex` decreases in that same action. On a higher epoch, the coordinator steps down in that same action. A link failure cannot fall between an extend and its effect, and a stale reply cannot arrive later. This narrows choice 2, which had left one reply slot. The predictions are unchanged.

## Mutations

Selected by `model/run.sh --mutation <id> <scenario>` and, for the shared files, by `model/run.sh --mutations`. The unmutated model is `Mutation = "none"`.

- `double_vote`, derives: J1.1. Used for S1, S2, S3. A candidate who belongs to its configuration becomes coordinator in the new epoch inside `Elect`, with no grants. The check that the voter has not voted for someone else in that epoch is skipped as well. Two members can be coordinator of one epoch.
- `skip_uptodate`, derives: J1.5. Used for S4, S5, S6, S7. The up-to-date check on a grant is skipped. `AdvanceCommit`, after it raises `commitIndex`, empties that coordinator's journal and latches `bad = "J1.5"`. The removed indexes are at or below the commit index just written.
- `wide_change`, derives: J1.3. Used for S8. An add inserts the named member and one other member of `{m1..m5}` outside that set. A remove deletes the named member and one other member of the current configuration. The appended entry differs by two members. TLC's `CHOOSE` picks the extra member canonically.

The scenario predictions were not edited after these runs. Each unmutated scenario and each mutation printed the predicted line.

S5 is the largest finished scenario: 2,426,356 distinct states, depth 29, 74 seconds. TLC's fingerprint estimate was `8.9E-7`, under the `1e-3` cutoff from amendment 3. The pre-registered explore envelope did not finish. With `MaxCrashes = 1`, `MaxAdmin = 3`, `MaxLinkFaults = 4`, and an event cap of 400, TLC at diameter 10 held 4,959,972 distinct states and 4,480,694 queued, and was still adding about 2.4 million distinct states a minute. The JVM was stopped. `model/run.sh --explore` printed `UNEXPLAINED bound`. No smaller fault envelope was substituted, so there is no explore PASS to read as coverage of S6's four cuts or S8's three configuration changes. The scenario results above were not changed because of this.

Trace counters had to leave the state view. A cycle can restore the journals, indexes, and roles while bumping `seq`. With the counter in the view, that cycle is a new state on every turn and the scenario graphs do not close. `led`, `crecs`, and `bad` stay in the view.

## Declared limitations

The finished checks are safety checks inside these bounds. `FairSpec` is defined and is not the specification TLC ran.

`MaxEpoch` is 3, `MaxLogLen` is 4, and `MaxRounds` is 3, for the reasons in the bounds table. A member starts an election only when all of the following hold: the member is in its own configuration; no other up member is already a candidate; and there is no up coordinator, of an epoch at least the member's own, with both link directions open. That last test does not look at whether the coordinator's configuration contains the member. `double_vote` skips it. Concurrent campaigns and the split votes they produce are outside the check. A removed member who can still exchange messages with such a coordinator does not campaign. There is no empty heartbeat once a follower is caught up. The reachable-coordinator test stands in for the timer reset the specification describes.

A ballot is one action, as in choice 1. An extend is one action with its effect. `matchIndex` and `nextIndex` update in that action, a rejected prefix decreases `nextIndex` in that action, and a higher epoch steps the coordinator down in that action. There is no reply record left for a later delivery. A stale reply cannot regress `matchIndex`. A link failure cannot fall between an extend and its effect.

The state view omits `obs`, `seq`, `seqEnv`, `appSeq`, `gseq`, and `events`. TLC keeps one state when two states differ only in those counters. The stored state still carries them, and a counterexample still rebuilds `model/observe/<run>.jsonl`.
